resources.string: The devices that share this library. A document stays in the trash past its retention until every active device has caught up, so no device can still be restoring it. Retire a device you no longer use, so it holds nothing back; one that stays silent for 90 days is left out by itself.
Retired: the trash does not wait for this device.
Silent for more than 90 days: the trash does not wait for this device.
No other device has caught up with this library yet. Devices on an older version of the app are not listed, and the trash does not wait for them.
Could not bring the device back: %1$s
